Cookie statement

This site sets no cookies of its own. There is no analytics package, no advertising network and no tracking script on any page.

What that means in practice

Nothing is stored in the browser between visits, and no consent banner is needed because there is nothing to consent to.

Other sites

Cookies set by other websites can be removed through the browser settings, under privacy and security in Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge.
